BEFORE THE NEW MEXICO PUBLIC REGULATION COMMISSION

 IN THE MATTER OF THE APPLICATION OF EL PASO
 ELECTRIC COMPANY FOR REVISION OF ITS                                 Docket No. 25-00082-UT
 RETAIL ELECTRIC RATES PURSUANT TO ADVICE
 NOTICE NO. 317

 EL PASO ELECTRIC COMPANY,

        Applicant.



        EL PASO ELECTRIC COMPANY’S RESPONSE TO ORDER ON EPE’S
         PROPOSED SECOND NOTICE AND SOCIAL MEDIA CAMPAIGN

       El Paso Electric Company (“EPE”) is submitting this filing pursuant to the Order on EPE’s

Proposed Second Notice and Social Media Campaign dated September 15, 2026, and provides the

following information:

       Attachment A attached hereto provides a complete table of rates showing a Residential

Typical Bill Comparison of EPE’s phase-in proposal, as requested in EPE’s Amended Application,

in the same format as the information that was provided in the “Continuation Notice to EPE

Customers.”

       Attachment B attached hereto provides the comparison of present and proposed rates for

each customer class as requested in EPE’s Amended Application in the same format as the

information that was provided in the “Continuation Notice to EPE Customers.”

       Attachment C attached hereto provides a description of the actual text that EPE’s

advertisement will utilize to communicate with users of the Meta platforms, and a more robust

explanation of the amount of communications that will be disseminated in the social media

campaign.

                                            Respectfully Submitted,
 Nancy B. Burns
El Paso Electric Company
300 Galisteo Street, Suite 206
Santa Fe, New Mexico 87501
Telephone (505) 982-7391
